references.text: Psalm 104:6 is a poetic retelling of the flood event in Genesis 7:20, where both verses confirm that the waters stood above the mountains as a sign of God's power.
Genesis 8:5 is the direct narrative counterpart to 7:20 and shows the flood cycle from covering to uncovering of the mountains.
Direct narrative connection within the same account: 7:10 marks the start of the flood, while 7:20 describes its peak.
